title: Tile Stack
description: Pick three matching farm tiles from layered stacks into a 7-slot tray, use undo, pop-out and shuffle tools, and clear every layer to win.
controls: Tap unblocked tiles to move them to the 7-slot tray; three matching tiles clear automatically. Use Undo, Pop-out and Shuffle wisely.

zh-CN.title: 叠叠消
zh-CN.description: 多层堆叠三消益智玩法：从层叠牌堆挑出三个相同图案消除，善用移出、撤回与洗牌通关。
zh-CN.controls: 点击未被遮挡的卡牌放入底部 7 格卡槽，凑齐 3 张相同卡牌自动消除；底部支持移出、撤回、洗牌道具。
